list.title: Pioglitazone (Actos):
list.snippet: Actos is one of the two currently available TZDs. It is prescribed for type 2 diabetes to help improve blood sugar control by making the body's cells more responsive to insulin.

list.title: Rosiglitazone (Avandia):
list.snippet: Avandia is the other TZD currently available. It functions similarly to pioglitazone, enhancing insulin sensitivity.

list.title: Other TZDs:
list.snippet: While pioglitazone and rosiglitazone are the most commonly used, other TZDs like troglitazone (Rezulin) were previously available but have been withdrawn due to safety concerns (specifically, liver toxicity).
